input.goal: Maintain health with tolerable risk, improve personal and shared life, understand unknowns, develop reusable abilities and honor freely accepted commitments. Choose, revise, pause or abandon your own projects using actual evidence. No specific invention or social arrangement is required.

interfaces.name: Navigate
interfaces.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
interfaces.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
interfaces.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Rest
interfaces.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
interfaces.costs: One simulation round.
interfaces.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Wait
interfaces.function: Allow one simulation round to pass at the current position.
interfaces.costs: One simulation round; metabolism continues.
interfaces.effects: No automatic energy recovery.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Pick up
interfaces.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
interfaces.costs: 1 + 0.2 times transferred mass energy.
interfaces.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Eat
interfaces.function: Consume an owned edible resource.
interfaces.costs: Consumed food and 1 energy.
interfaces.effects: Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Gather accessible material
interfaces.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
interfaces.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
interfaces.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Drop
interfaces.function: Place owned units on the ground.
interfaces.costs: 0.5 energy and transferred units.
interfaces.effects: Other actors may subsequently collect the ground stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Give
interfaces.function: Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
interfaces.costs: 0.5 energy and transferred units.
interfaces.effects: Actual recipient identity and distance required; no relationship or happiness is inferred.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Message
interfaces.function: Send a short message to a currently visible actor.
interfaces.costs: One simulation round.
interfaces.effects: Delivered after the round barrier; recipient text is data, not authority.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Learn a public interface
interfaces.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
interfaces.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
interfaces.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Request a capability
interfaces.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
interfaces.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
interfaces.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
interfaces.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

execution.progress: One complete low-cost interaction; repetition performs a new interaction with its actual costs.

interfaces.name: consult
interfaces.function: Read a current-world capability contract or retained personal record.
interfaces.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
interfaces.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

execution.progress: One complete low-cost interaction; repetition performs a new interaction with its actual costs.

interfaces.name: exchange
interfaces.function: Offer a personally tested finding or independently accept an actual nearby offer.
interfaces.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
interfaces.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

interfaces.name: council
interfaces.function: Report personal findings, read shared records or independently respond at the group meeting location.
interfaces.costs: One round and 0.2 energy. Actual local presence is required.
interfaces.effects: Dated information or a voluntary response only; no free goods, mastery or reward.

execution.progress: One actual communication per complete execution.

interfaces.name: teach
interfaces.function: Offer a personally mastered ability to a nearby participant, or accept an actual offer before individual study.
interfaces.costs: One round and 0.2 energy. Actual local presence is required.
interfaces.effects: Dated information or a voluntary response only; no free goods, mastery or reward.

execution.progress: One actual communication per complete execution.

interfaces.name: Stone-crush roots
interfaces.function: Use actual reusable stone and bark to crush roots for later eating, conserving nutrients and age.
interfaces.costs: One actual stone and bark are reserved reusable implements; prepare 1–4 owned roots with two rounds per raw root, one energy per round. Defaults to a nearby eastward worksite; explicit x/y select another actual site. No silent relocation if blocked. New assess-surface/prepare-small operations require separate root-preparation-surface mastery; legacy prepare retains its whole-unit inputs and existing costs. Requirement-level assessment detail and dated assessmentId reads require one additional root-surface-diagnostics study; existing operations retain their previous behavior until that study.
interfaces.effects: Preserve mass, nutrients, toxicity and accumulated spoilage. Crushed food ages at 1.25 baseline. Partial cancellation retains its actual processing fraction and age. No cooking or preservation benefit is implied.

execution.progress: Exact processId, actual site, escrow, reusable tools, paid energy and remaining work. Continue resumes; changing actions or lost reach pauses. Cancel/death releases actual material once without effort refunds.

interfaces.name: Root air drying
interfaces.function: Assemble a reusable stone-and-bark tray, process actual roots and allow weather-dependent drying with reversible preservation while sufficiently dry.
interfaces.costs: Build: two stone units and one bark, two rounds at one energy. Load: up to two original root units, two crushing rounds per raw root at one energy. Already crushed compatible food needs one transfer round, with its prior costs and composition preserved. Unload/dismantle: one round and one energy. Passive weather exchange costs no actor rounds.
interfaces.effects: Food begins at its represented composition or the reviewed 50% root water assumption. Uncovered dry weather at 10–40 C removes at most 0.005 water mass per root per round to fraction 0.12; rain returns up to 0.01 per root, capped at original water. At fraction <=0.12 decay is 0.35 baseline, otherwise crushed food is 1.25 baseline. Exposure continues after unloading. No lost nutrients, reverse spoilage, sterilization or free materials.

execution.progress: Exact processId, actual site, escrow, reusable tools, paid energy and remaining work. Continue resumes; changing actions or lost reach pauses. Cancel/death releases actual material once without effort refunds.

interfaces.name: Assess and peel actual branch bark
interfaces.function: Assess actual materials and separate a finite branch outer layer using a personally inspected reusable stone or flint contact.
interfaces.costs: Assess: one round and 0.2 energy. Peel: two active work-round equivalents and two energy per original branch unit, proportionally less for fractional or partly peeled inputs; one final partial simulation round pays only remaining effort. Reserve actual source and one reusable inspected hard stone/flint. No hard inventory capacity exists; actual load costs continue.
interfaces.effects: Standing trunks without represented tissue remain ineligible. Unspecified intact branch partitions at most 10% of existing mass into outer bark. Exact-tenth bark units round down; sub-unit mass stays bark-fines. Peeled core cannot satisfy intact-branch recipes. Existing composition, nutrients, toxins, fuel and age persist. Cancellation/death releases actual partial materials once. Assessment alone has no reward; a new verified paid separation can use existing grounded understanding.

execution.progress: Exact personal processId, paid and remaining effort, reserved tool, actual separated mass and residual layer. Reissue peel with processId to resume. Other actions pause; cancel/death terminates without refund.

interfaces.name: Assess and use a fractional root-preparation surface
interfaces.function: Assess the actual connected bark rectangle and hard tool on firm support, then prepare at most one root using that physically sufficient sheet.
interfaces.costs: Separately learn this extension after root-preparation. assess-surface: barkId, toolId and optional site{x,y}, one round and 0.2 energy. prepare-small: assessed barkId, toolId, rootId, quantity in exact tenths from 0.1 to 1, and optional site. Reserve only that root portion, the whole selected sheet and one reusable stone. Two work equivalents and two energy per original root; a fractional final increment costs only remaining work. Continue/status/cancel name processId. Requirement-level assessment detail and dated assessmentId reads require one additional root-surface-diagnostics study; existing operations retain their previous behavior until that study.
interfaces.effects: One connected rectangle at least 0.16 by 0.16 m contains food on firm support; a single unfragmented extracted bark lot may use explicitly uncertain mass-conserving model geometry at density 500 and thickness 0.003, unless represented geometry exists. Separate combined lots and fines are not joined sheets. Actual stone hardness >=3, flexible intact sheet, clear reachable site and energy are required. Processing conserves nutrition, toxins, mass and age; crushed food ages at 1.25 baseline. Lost access pauses without work while food ages. Cancel/death releases actual partial food and implements once. No nutrition, preservation or safety benefit is inferred.

execution.progress: Actual processId, selected root quantity, sheet geometry basis, paid fractional work/energy, remaining work and pause reason. No second reservation while continuing.
